verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents per-agent scoped delegation. Agent wallet signers carry a spend cap, allowed counterparties and a time window enforced onchain, and users can revoke at any time. Agent cards are order intents with a fixed allowance, expiration and merchant lock that stop working when cancelled. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and explicit documentation of how quickly revocation takes effect ("instant" is not stated).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set per-agent spend caps and usage limits and revoke an agent's payment authority instantly

citations.quote: The user owns a non-custodial wallet and grants the agent scoped permissions (spend limit, counterparties, time window), enforced onchain.
Permissions are enforced onchain. The user can revoke at any time.
It stops working when cancelled, expired, or fully spent.
Save a user's card once and issue scoped, revocable agent cards from it
An agent card is an order intent that gives an agent a bounded amount to spend before a fixed expiration.
